segments.name: Banking
segments.description: Provides banking services, including deposits and lending, to individuals, businesses and other organizations in Ohio and West Virginia.
segments.evidence: The Company's has one reportable segment ("Banking") as determined by the after considering the level of information to review and the performance of various components of the business.

revenueModel.text: The Company earns interest on loans and investments and fees from deposit service charges, mortgage banking and treasury management services paid by its customers.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company's primary deposit products are checking, savings and term certificate accounts and its primary lending products are residential mortgage, commercial and installment loans.
